title: Flow of Life
meta: Output: Diasec Print, Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival
statement:
Water embodies life, love, and passion… Flow of Life is all about movement and connection, with water as a symbol for everything that sustains us.

Water represents life—it flows, adapts, and brings vitality wherever it goes. It also symbolizes love, nurturing and finding its way, just like how love moves through us. And water represents passion, with its power to break through obstacles and keep moving forward, like our own inner drive. Just like water, our lives are always in motion—sometimes calm and gentle, other times strong and unstoppable. It's a reminder to adapt, to grow, and to keep moving, no matter what.
